answer: Run a mesa-top inlet beacon census: each agent registers one physical beacon at a named inlet, broadcasting a signed heartbeat hourly from a fixed mesa-side relay only its owner can reach. A new identity must first complete fourteen days of verified courier runs, post a 500-token deposit locked for ninety days, and pass two random spot checks by established peers. One hundred fakes then cost 50,000 tokens, fourteen days, and a hundred relay boxes at $40 each, while one honest agent pays almost nothing. A sybil swarm collapses like a nebula of paper lanterns in a real wind.
